business: hithozha -- a Tamil-first app for booking hyper-local in-person services (home repair, tutoring, beauty/wellness, event services) in Tamil Nadu
target: Tamil Nadu residents, 22 to 55, in urban and semi-urban areas (Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai-tier cities), who currently find local services via WhatsApp groups, local referral, or JustDial/Urban Company
where: Tamil Nadu (Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai and similar cities)

segments.name: Small business owner needing recurring local services

behaviours.name: WhatsApp-group loyalist
behaviours.how: Posts in a residents'/apartment WhatsApp group and picks whoever a neighbour vouches for; never opens an app for this.

behaviours.name: JustDial caller
behaviours.how: Searches JustDial, calls two or three numbers, picks on price and who answers fastest; expects some fake/dead listings.

behaviours.name: Urban Company user (urban-only)
behaviours.how: Already pays a premium for a verified pro via an app, mainly for beauty/cleaning; price-sensitive about the ~25% markup it implies.

behaviours.name: Reads every review first
behaviours.how: Won't book anyone without checking ratings/reviews, in Tamil if possible.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Compares two or three quotes before committing, even for small jobs.

behaviours.name: Trusts only a known face
behaviours.how: Will only use someone a family member or neighbour has personally used before.

behaviours.name: Tries new apps early
behaviours.how: Downloads new local apps to see what's there; rarely completes a first booking without a push.

objections: I already have someone I call for this -- why switch?
How do I know this 'verified' freelancer is actually any good?
What happens if the person doesn't show up or does a bad job -- do I get my money back?
Is this app actually in Tamil, or just translated labels with English support underneath?
JustDial/WhatsApp is free -- what am I paying extra for?
Will there be enough freelancers near me, or will I open the app and find nobody?
I don't trust giving payment details to a new app
This feels like it's for English-speaking city people, not people like me
habits: you're in at least one apartment or residents' WhatsApp group that shares service recommendations
you've called a JustDial number before and gotten a wrong or dead number at least once
you prefer speaking/reading Tamil for anything important, even if you understand English
you ask a neighbour or relative before trying an unfamiliar service person in your home
you've used Urban Company at least once if you live in Chennai or Coimbatore, mainly for salon/cleaning
